title: Pixel Lantern
authorship: Original composition authored for this project; no source melody or MIDI sequence copied
brief: An original NES-style overworld loop in C major at 150 BPM: two pulses, a stepped triangle, noise drums.

sections.intent: the theme on a 25% pulse, arpeggio chords
longer notes, the second pulse answers
the theme on a 12.5% pulse with an echo
A minor, then the climb back to the start
